pillars.name: The model narrates, code rules
pillars.text: The model writes prose and typed proposals only; application code validates and commits every state change.

pillars.name: SQLite is the authority
pillars.text: The Game-State Ledger is the only authority for game state; the model never writes to it.

pillars.name: Preserve the player's work
pillars.text: Invalid model output rejects the whole turn, database errors roll back, migrations and restores back up first, and a damaged ledger opens an in-memory recovery session.

pillars.name: Local and private
pillars.text: Everything runs on the player's machine; model endpoints stay localhost-only and Unsloth server-side tools are never enabled.

pillars.name: Saves keep loading
pillars.text: Schema migrations are append-only; existing saved campaigns must keep loading.
